## 🌅 Morning Routine Checklist
- [ ] Wake up
- [ ] Drink water
- [ ] Meditate / breathe (10 min)
- [ ] Morning stretch or movement
- [ ] Breakfast
- [ ] Review this briefing
- [ ] Set 3 intentions for the day

## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das liegt mir am Herzen** — [dahs leekt meer ahm HAIR-tsen] — *That's close to my heart / I care deeply about that*
2. **Ich bin ganz bei dir** — [ish bin gahnts by deer] — *I'm fully with you / I completely agree*
3. **Es fügt sich alles** — [ess fookt zish AH-les] — *Everything falls into place*
